abstract: The remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) has provided important inspiration for the next generation of recommender systems. Structurally, recommendation and language generation share a similarity: both aim to produce an ordered sequence that optimizes the user's experience. However, how to precisely absorb the essence of the LLM paradigm into mature industrial recommender systems remains an open problem. There are two challenges. First, it is unclear how to incorporate the LLM paradigm -- sequence-level generation and optimization -- into recommendation. Second, real-world recommender systems are mature systems that have been iteratively customized for years around specific products, business constraints, serving infrastructure, and organizational ownership. Replacing such systems wholesale is often technically risky and organizationally disruptive. In this paper, we propose LIGE-GR, a listwise generation and evaluation recommendation framework that upgrades from a traditional ranking system (itemwise recommendation) toward a generative recommendation paradigm. Instead of rebuilding the entire recommendation stack from scratch, LIGE-GR generalizes the existing pointwise recommendation system into a listwise generation system. This allows mature recommender systems to benefit from listwise optimization while preserving compatibility with existing models, value functions, and serving infrastructure. We validate LIGE-GR in short-video recommendation on Instagram Reels and Facebook Video. On these recommendation surfaces, LIGE-GR improves time spent by 1.14 percent on Instagram Reels and 0.72 percent on Facebook Video, while requiring only modest additional inference resources.
key_ideas:
🔸在现有无上下文排序模型之上叠加轻量上下文模块：四头四层的GPT式因果Transformer，复用中间表示v′t，条件于已选列表前缀重新预测参与度信号。
🔸将价值模型从逐项求和升级为列表级：引入继续观看概率pcontinue递归估计用户到达每个位置的概率，对各项贡献加权（ListVMgolden），同时保留控制层多样性调整CL。
🔸Palette解码器以束搜索+价值RL形式逐位置扩展子序列，Q值由已实现列表价值加未来价值估计F̂组成；F̂用基于平均分数与继续概率的闭式近似，并做时长感知修正以避免偏好短视频的偏差。
🔸服务路径两阶段：先按原有流程计算并缓存无上下文表示，再仅对约三分之一头部候选做自回归重打分；束扩展批量执行，超时或失败时逐请求回退到原逐项解码。
🔸框架严格泛化原系统：切换回CF、b=1、pcontinue≡1、F̂=0即可完整恢复现有系统，实现配置级回滚与独立迭代。
analysis_summary:
🔸线上A/B显示基础配置使Instagram Reels时长+1.14%、Facebook Video时长+0.72%（p<0.001），b=6时长感知配置在Reels上相对b=1再提升时长+0.69%、点赞+2.93%。
🔸上下文感知预测在全部展示任务族上改善NE，如Reels的Continue任务提升1.57%；Facebook Video 17项任务中15项改善、最差回退不超过0.07%。
🔸成本可控：基础配置额外推理资源约等于CF组件的10%，b=6约20%，Reels端到端延迟约增加7%，Facebook Video平均服务延迟约增加2.2%。
🔸生态诊断显示主题熵、创作者多样性、探索性提升，但72小时内新视频占比下降0.66%，存在新鲜度回退。
🔸局限：候选池规模限于数百量级，未来需结合Semantic ID等技术支持更大候选空间。
personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文最突出的创新不在单一算法，而在升级路径设计：把生成式列表优化做成对成熟排序系统的严格泛化，兼顾技术可回滚与组织可接受性，这在工业界极具实用价值。三项组件可独立启用、渐进演进，配合缓存表示与裁剪候选池实现约10%额外推理资源的高性价比。局限方面，上下文模块架构较轻（仅四层），捕获长程列表依赖的能力有限；未来价值估计采用闭式近似而非学习型模型；候选池仅在数百量级，距离真正的端到端生成推荐仍有距离；且收益数字来自特定流量与延迟口径，跨产品不可直接比较。整体是一个务实且有前瞻空间的过渡框架。
